 Sp. Prague vs Bournemouth: Recent results
 Sparta Prague have won one, drawn two and lost two of their past five competitive matches. Their latest outing ended in a 0-0 draw with Bohemians 1905 Prague. They also thrashed Slovacko 5-1, but lost 2-0 to Banik Ostrava in the cup and 1-0 to Olympiakos Piraeus in the Europa League. Across those five games, Sparta scored six goals and conceded three.
 Bournemouth have won their last five competitive matches without conceding a goal. Most recently, they beat Leeds United 2-0 in the Premier League. Before that, they defeated Aston Villa 3-0 in the EFL Cup and AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League. They scored ten goals and conceded none across the five matches.
